title: Implement user authentication with email+password and Google OAuth
acceptance_criteria: Credentials provider with email/password login and bcrypt password hashing
Google OAuth provider configured for one-click social login
Database sessions active: session created on login, destroyed on logout
tenant_id embedded in session on login (from users.tenant_id)
Signup creates user record linked to existing tenant (via invite), or creates new tenant if standalone
Login redirects to dashboard for existing users, to onboarding for new signups
Password reset flow: forgot password → email with reset link → new password
